summary: Sungtaek Cho works in Buddhist studies and philosophy. He studied economics at Konkuk University and Korea University. He held positions at Stony Brook University, Korea University (Director attested 2012–2017, Research Professor 2019–2020), and Gyeonggi Research Institute (2020).
Sunhee Kim completed a Doctor of Philosophy in Performance Practice at the University of Exeter under the doctoral supervision of Phillip B. Zarrilli (attested 2013).

Suniti Kumar Chatterji was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Scottish Church College, Presidency University, University of Calcutta, University of London under Lionel David Barnett, and in Paris under Jules Bloch. He was Khaira Professor at the University of Calcutta (1922–1952).

Sunny Kumar is an Indologist who earned his Ph.D. from Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University (2013–2015). In 2016, he served as an Assistant Professor at Gorakshanath Government Sanskrit College.
Supree Kanjanapisarn is a scholar of religious studies and philosophy who completed a PhD at Assumption University under the doctoral supervision of Veerachart Nimanong (attested 2011).

Surabhi Verma specializes in Indology and philosophy. She completed her Ph.D. at Panjab University (2012–2015) and was appointed Assistant Professor at the National Institute of Technology Rourkela in 2015.

Surama Dasgupta was an Indologist and philosopher who studied under Surendranath Dasgupta, earned M.A. and Ph.D. degrees from the University of Calcutta, and completed a Ph.D. at the University of Cambridge (1948). She served as Reader at the University of Lucknow.
Suren Naicker works in linguistics, Indology, and religious studies. He earned a D Litt et Phil from the University of South Africa, where he also held a post.
Surendra Man Bajracharya is a scholar in Buddhist studies who earned a PhD at Tribhuvan University under doctoral supervisor Bhadra Ratna Bajracharya and co-supervisor Ranjana Bajracharya.

Surendranath Dasgupta was an Indologist and philosopher. He earned doctorates at Calcutta and Cambridge, studying under McTaggart and Ward. His posts included Principal of Sanskrit College and University (~1931–1942) and Chair of Philosophy at the University of Calcutta (~1942–1945).
Surendranath Majumdar Sastri was an Indologist and historian who studied under traditional teacher Hara Prasad Sastri. He served as a Reader at Patna University (attested 1924).

Suresha R. is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who was at the University of Mysore (2013) and held an Assistant Professor post at Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (attested 2026).
Surya Das is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar. He studied at the University at Buffalo (~1968–1971) and trained under traditional teacher Nyoshul Khenpo Rinpoche.

Surya Kanta was an Indologist and linguist who earned a D.Phil. at the University of Oxford (1937) under Frederick William Thomas. He served as Reader in Sanskrit at the University of the Punjab (attested 1939).

Surya Tahora works in philosophy and Indology. He studied at Aix-Marseille University, INSEAD, Paris-Sud University, and Arsha Vidya Gurukulam. In 2021, he served as Executive Director at S. P. Jain Institute of Management and Research.

Suryakumar Bhuyan was a historian and Indologist who studied at Cotton University, Presidency University, University of Calcutta, and SOAS. He was Principal at Cotton University (1918) and Vice Chancellor of Gauhati University (~1957–1960).

Suryanarayana Shukla was an Indology, linguistics, and philosophy scholar who studied at Rajgopal Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya under Nandakishore Pandey, Ramanujacharya, and Shridatta Pandey. He held a professorship at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University.

Susan Andrews is a scholar of Buddhist studies and sinology. She earned her PhD at Columbia University (attested 2013) under doctoral supervisor Chün-fang Yü, also studying under Bernard Faure, David Max Moerman, Michael I. Como, Koichi Shinohara, and Phyllis Granoff.

Susan Hawthorne works in Indology and philosophy. She earned degrees from Melbourne Teachers' College, La Trobe University, University of Melbourne (PhD 2002), and Australian National University. In 2018, she was an Adjunct Professor at James Cook University.

Susan J. Rosenfield is an Indologist who completed her PhD at Harvard University in 2004. Her teachers included Stephanie W. Jamison, George L. Hart, Kausalya Hart, Shaligram Shukla, Saudamani Deshmukh, James W. Benson, and Thomas Burke.
